description: This file defines the FormRenderer class, a core component responsible for rendering various types of forms (single, list, multi, upload) within the OFBiz framework. It manages form layout, header, rows, fields, and their rendering logic, including handling of hidden fields, field groups, pagination, and dynamic content expansion.

classes.name: FormRenderer
classes.description: A class responsible for rendering forms in the OFBiz framework, supporting multiple form types and complex layout management.

methods.name: getCurrentContainerId
methods.description: Generates the current container ID based on the form model and context, considering item indices.

methods.name: getCurrentFormName
methods.description: Determines the current form name, appending item index if the form is a list type.

methods.name: getFocusFieldName
methods.description: Retrieves the focus field name from the context for the form.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Main method to render the form to a writer, dispatching to specific render methods based on form type.

methods.name: renderHeaderRow
methods.description: Renders the header row of a form, including column titles and layout.

methods.name: renderHiddenIgnoredFields
methods.description: Renders hidden and ignored fields within the form.

methods.name: renderItemRow
methods.description: Renders a single row of form fields, handling layout, grouping, and field types.

methods.name: renderItemRows
methods.description: Iterates over list items to render multiple rows of form data.

methods.name: renderListFormString
methods.description: Renders a list-style form with headers and rows.

methods.name: renderMultiFormString
methods.description: Renders a multi-item form with pagination and layout.

methods.name: renderSingleFormString
methods.description: Renders a single form, including hidden fields, layout, and field groups.

methods.name: filteringDuplicateNames
methods.description: Returns a predicate to filter out duplicate field names during rendering.

methods.name: checkFormData
methods.description: Checks if form data exists in the context for rendering.

methods.name: safeNext
methods.description: Safely advances an iterator, returning null if no more elements.
